original_benchmark.notes: EvoEval v0.1.0 data release (evo-eval/evoeval_release). The original harness prompts an LLM once per problem and scores the sanitized completion with evoeval.evaluate (pass@1).

harbor_adapter.notes: All 100 EvoEval_difficult problems; no exclusions. Parity on all 100 tasks, 3 runs per side. Other EvoEval datasets can be generated with --dataset but are not part of this release.
